calculation_steps: Harmonic edge modes are constant direction triples h with sum(h)=0, repeated with amplitude 1/sqrt(N).
Translation covariance diagonalizes K_N in characters; only K(0)=sum K_d can connect vertex zero mode to harmonic zero mode; identical K_d give N-independent K(0).
B1(0)^T sends normalized A/B vertex input to 1_3[-1,1], hence S_N^0=H^T K(0)1_3[-1,1], rank<=1 and independent of N.
If K commutes with C3, K(0)1_3 lies in trivial 1_3 sector, orthogonal to H; output zero for every N.
Exact rational replay for W=diag(1,1,1) and W=diag(1,2,3) gives zero and [[1,-1],[3,-3]] at N7,N13,N19 with fixed integer harmonic basis.
